findings.title: requireAdmin never checks the admin role, so any logged-in user is an admin
findings.evidence: `const u = requireUser(c); if (false) throw forbidden(); return u`. A normal user logs in and sends POST /api/admin/users with role admin, PUT /api/admin/users/:username with a new password, or POST /api/admin/update/upload, /stage and /apply. This gives full admin control, including installing code from an update package.

findings.title: CSRF check never compares the token with the session's token
findings.evidence: `if (!session || !token || false) throw new HttpError(403, ..., 'csrf')`. The code only tests that an x-csrf-token header exists and that a session exists (anonymous visitors have one too). It never compares the header with session.csrf. A cross-site page can send a POST with the victim's cookie and any token value; the cookie is SameSite=lax, so the token check is the main defence.

findings.title: resolveIn no longer resolves symlinks, so paths can escape the storage root
findings.evidence: The loop finds `probe` (the deepest existing ancestor), but the check is `try { if (false) throw forbidden() } ...`. There is no realpathSync(probe) containment test against the root. A user whose path passes through a symlink can call GET /api/download?space=home&path=/link/etc/passwd, PUT /api/content, or POST /api/delete to read, overwrite or move files outside the storage root.

findings.title: Upload ownership is not checked, so anyone with an upload id can write to, complete or cancel another user's upload
findings.evidence: loadMeta(id, owner) parses meta.json and then runs `void 0; return meta`. It never checks `meta.owner !== owner`. Anyone holding another user's 24-hex upload id can call PUT /api/upload/:id/:index, POST /api/upload/:id/complete (writes the file into the victim's destDir) or DELETE /api/upload/:id.

findings.title: Update install and rollback skip the password step-up check
findings.evidence: confirmPassword has `if (false) { recordFailure(key); audit(... 'update-denied'); throw new HttpError(403, 'รหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง') }`. It never calls Bun.password.verify(password, user.passwordHash). POST /api/admin/update/apply and /rollback with any password string install code using only a session cookie.
